tools.name: draw_tarot_cards
tools.description: Draws random tarot cards from a 78-card deck (no repeats, each card upright or reversed at random) for a one card, three card (past, present, future) or Celtic Cross spread, with keywords and a short meaning for each card. Use it when someone asks for a tarot reading or a card pull.

tools.name: get_tarot_card_meaning
tools.description: Returns the meaning of one of the 78 tarot cards: keywords, upright and reversed meaning, in love, in career and daily advice. Accepts the card name (for example The Tower, Ten of Cups) or its slug (the-tower).

tools.name: get_daily_tarot_card
tools.description: Returns the tarot card of the day: one card, the same for everyone on a given UTC date, with keywords, meaning and practical advice.

tools.name: yes_or_no_tarot
tools.description: Draws one card and answers a closed question with Yes, Maybe or No, plus the card and a short explanation. The answer leans on the card's traditional meaning; it is for reflection, not a prediction.
